item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a convex mirror used as the side-view mirror on Mahika's scooter. Drivers use such mirrors to see more of the traffic behind them.

Mahika compares this mirror with a plane mirror of the same size.

parts.text: Why is a convex mirror chosen for this use?

options.text: It forms erect, smaller images and gives a wider field of view than a plane mirror.
It forms a magnified image so vehicles behind look larger than life.
A concave mirror would give the same wide view for the same mirror size.
It is chosen only because the glass looks shiny.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.
